text:
maria_cs: Quick ask from Stargrove Diagnostics: they need a temporary EU egress allowlist + QPS increase for a paid customer demo tomorrow morning. They said demo performance will influence renewal talks. Can netops provision fast?

ritesh_netops: Share exact IPs and the demo time window. Also what's the expected sustained QPS and peak burst?

maria_cs: Provided IPs below and window. They want auto-revoke after demo.
```
203.0.113.45/32
198.51.100.0/24
```
Window: 2026-03-26 09:00-11:30 UTC. Target sustained 120 QPS, allow bursts to 250.

ritesh_netops: 198.51.100.0/24 is too broad for eu-edge. Ask them to reduce to /28 or list /32s. I can do a short-term rule + QPS bump but need a ticket and a rollback owner. Will attach alerts at 75% and set auto-revoke.

sam_support: Ticket created: INF-4592 with details + requested window: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INF-4592. Owner assigned to @ritesh_netops for provisioning.

jen_prod: Proposed execution: 1) create allowlist rule scoped to eu-edge; 2) set qps=120, burst=250; 3) enable prefix caching for the customer's prefix; 4) monitor 5m rolling latency and errors; 5) auto-revoke at 11:45 UTC (15m post-demo). If latency >200ms or 5xxs spike >1%, rollback and notify CSM.

infra-bot: infra-bot: allowlist created: rule-9402, scope=eu-edge, auto_revoke=2026-03-26T11:45:00Z, ticket=INF-4592 :white_check_mark:

maria_cs: Pushed back to customer to tighten CIDR to /28 or provide specific /32s. Also flagged as renewal risk in Gainsight  they said if demo fails they may push to Dedicated.

ritesh_netops: I'll apply the QPS change now: qps=120, burst=250. Setting capacity alert at 75% and pager to eng-oncall if crossed. Documented fallback to gcp-eu cluster if eu-edge saturates.

sam_support: Customer informed; calendar event created with reminders and a post-demo feedback slot. We'll gather telemetry and console traces.

maria_cs: Thanks team. Will update the account renewal notes and capture demo outcome. Please leave logs/metrics in ticket INF-4592 for post-mortem. :thumbsup:
